name: io.github.mahdi-salmanzade/mcp-dubai
title: MCP Dubai
description: Dubai and UAE public data plus curated business setup knowledge across 120 MCP tools.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DUBAI_PULSE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Dubai Pulse OAuth client id. Optional; unlocks the Tier 1 dld and rta live tools.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DUBAI_PULSE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Dubai Pulse OAuth client secret. Optional; used together with the client id.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DUBAI_WAQI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free WAQI token from aqicn.org. Optional; unlocks the air_quality tools.
